title: Provision Order Archive Disk
description:
**SITUATION:**

Order archives must survive Pod restarts and reschedules. Today, anything written inside a container’s filesystem disappears when the Pod is replaced — fine for temp files, bad for cold order history QuickByte must keep for months.

Someone on the platform team has to **register a chunk of durable disk with the cluster** so apps can use it later. You are that person for this lab. You are **not** wiring Order Processor to the disk yet — that comes in the next challenge, when an app team “asks” for storage and mounts it.

This lab registers durable disk as a **PersistentVolume** — platform inventory, not an app mount yet. Claiming and mounting that disk into Order Processor is the next challenge.
**YOUR TASK:**

1. Create a **PersistentVolume** (PV) that describes 1Gi of archive disk for the cluster.
2. Verify it shows up as **Available** (registered and free — nothing is using it yet).

**SPEC:**

- PersistentVolume name: `order-archive-pv`
- Capacity: `1Gi`
- Access modes: `["ReadWriteOnce"]`
- Reclaim policy: `Retain`
- Storage class name: `manual` (set `storageClassName: manual`)
- Volume mode: `Filesystem`
- Backing: `hostPath` path `/mnt/data/order-archive` (lab stand-in for real networked / cloud disk)

**CONSTRAINTS:**

- Manifest file: `order-archive-pv-l18.yaml`.
- Do **not** mount this disk into a Pod in this challenge — only register the volume.
- A PersistentVolume is cluster-scoped (not namespaced); still do not use `default` for any namespaced work.

hints: Your namespace is in the lab chrome and in $LEARNER_NS — kubectl already defaults there.
Work only in your lab namespace (not default).
Read SPEC carefully, apply your YAML, then Submit.
problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Provision Order Archive Disk

Register 1Gi of archive disk as a cluster-scoped PersistentVolume. Do not mount it into a Pod yet.

Docs: [PersistentVolumes](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/)

## Solution YAML

Save as `order-archive-pv-l18.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: order-archive-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 1Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  storageClassName: manual
  volumeMode: Filesystem
  hostPath:
    path: /mnt/data/order-archive
```

## Declarative

```bash
kubectl apply -f order-archive-pv-l18.yaml
kubectl get pv order-archive-pv
```

Wait until the PV is **Available**, then **Submit**.
